pose: The adult Dakotaraptor is shown with its back turned, departing the scene. Approaching from the opposite side, the REF_AVISAURUS_ADULT and REF_QUETZALCOATLUS_ADULT enter the clearing, excitedly picking apart the Orodromeus remains. The Orodromeus carcass is now fully skeletonized, reduced strictly to the skull and ribcage bones, showing no remaining soft tissue.

render_parameters.negative_constraints: No graphic violence, strictly toy-like 'X' eye effect on skull, no text, no labels, no borders, no extraneous people or IDs, strictly two arms per dinosaur (excluding Quetzalcoatlus), no negative space
